title: Chapter 289 A Sneak Attack
content:
Chapter 289 A Sneak Attack

In the face of a powerful enemy, they are still killing each other.

This is simply the scum of humanity.

People who live too comfortably have always liked to do such things to kill everyone.

"Don't act rashly, all of you retreat to the territory and wait for us to come back."

Wang Shuo's three cavalry units are all active within the 50-kilometer range of the territory, while the city defense army is only within the 15-kilometer range of the territory. It seems that the enemy has already found a place not far from Wana Town.

Wang Shuo has already identified this group of people as enemies.

"Abu, Good, return to the territory as soon as possible."

Wang Shuo conveyed the order to the two through the friend channel.

Half a day later, everyone returned to Wana Town.

In the meeting hall.

"Baili Liang, tell me about the situation."

Wang Shuo said in a serious voice.

Others were confused and waited quietly for Baili Liang to speak.

"My Lord, four hours ago, when we were dispersing in columns to clean up small groups of undead skeletons, three teams of centurions suddenly reported to me that they were attacked by a team of warriors in tight uniforms. When we rushed over to support them, there were only corpses on the ground."

"According to the wounds, it should be caused by samurai swords, and only Tiancun near us has special soldiers such as samurai."

"My Lord, please avenge our dead brothers!"

"This revenge must be avenged. Good, you lead the archers now and find out where they are now? How many people are there?"

"Yes."

"In addition, Abu, you collect all the dead spirit beads that are full of death energy, and I will purify the death energy inside."

"Yes."

Purifying the death energy is also very simple, just use a drop of water of life to soak it.

Wang Shuo has experimented before that after diluting a drop of water of life, tens of thousands of dead spirit beads can be purified at a time.

The effect of water of life is really outrageous.

While waiting for the news, Wang Shuo inspected his territory.

The newly joined people were quickly integrated into the big family under a series of process arrangements.

Stable social relations are the most effective means to alleviate confusion and anxiety.

Just at this time, in a remote corner, Wang Shuo actually found a beggar.

Wang Shuo showed a look of surprise.

"Wenxi, what's going on?"

"Boss, don't you recognize him? This is Mao Qiang!"

Wang Shuo tried to recall and remembered this person.

This is the person who instigated everyone to replace him when the territory was first built.

He can only say that he has brought this upon himself.

"Boss, you don't know that he is very famous in the hearts of the people, even more famous than me. He is now the most typical person who is despised in our town."

Wang Shuo thought clearly about the whole story and no longer cared about it. With such a negative example here, he can always remind those who have ulterior motives.

After walking for a while, Wang Shuo came to the blacksmith shop.

"Lord, why are you here?" Wu Dong walked over quickly and saluted Wang Shuo.

"Brother Duan." He greeted Duan Wenxi again.

Wu Dong was no longer the little apprentice he used to be. He was a manager who managed hundreds of blacksmiths, and his own blacksmith level had reached a high level.

"Have you encountered any difficulties in your work recently?"

"My Lord, our blacksmith shop is now developing well. We can produce thousands of weapons and armors every day, and tens of thousands of ammunition and arrows."

"If there is any difficulty, it is that the consumption of ore cannot keep up with our productivity. At the same time, the scale of the blacksmith shop is a bit small, and there is no land for us to expand in this place, so I want to move the blacksmith shop to the second ring."

Now everyone has called the inner city wall the first ring and the outer city wall the second ring.
